title: The logarithmic Brunn-Minkowski inequality
description: Support functions and Wulff bodies; the logarithmic Brunn-Minkowski inequality for origin-symmetric convex bodies and its reduction to a variance bound for soft polytopes; the additive inequality for powers between 0 and 1. The course is the start of an exposition of OpenAI's proof (2026) of the logarithmic Brunn-Minkowski inequality; the variance bound is not yet in the course.

units.title: Wulff bodies and the reduction to a variance bound

prerequisites: the Lebesgue integral in R^n with the theorems of dominated and monotone convergence (core course Measure and Integration)
compact convex sets in R^n and Hoelder's inequality for finite sums; the lesson proves the facts about support functions that it uses
